Global Dating & Matchmaking App – Development Requirements

Platforms: iOS and Android
Project Type: Global Dating & Matchmaking Application

1. Project Overview

* Develop a modern, secure, scalable dating application for iOS and Android.
* Support users worldwide across all countries, states and cities.
* Focus on genuine profiles, face verification, privacy, location-based discovery and secure communication.

* Apple Sign-In.
* Mandatory 18+ age restriction.

* Secure login and logout.
* Account deletion and deactivation.

3. Face Verification & Genuine Profiles

* AI-based face verification.
* Live selfie capture.
* Facial recognition and liveness detection.
* Compare selfie with profile photographs.
* Detect fake photographs and duplicate accounts.
* Manual verification for suspicious cases.
* Display a verified badge on approved profiles.
* Allow users to filter verified profiles only.
* Re-verification when suspicious activity is detected.

4. User Profile Management

Allow users to create and manage profiles with:

* Name and date of birth.
* Gender.
* Sexual orientation.
* Interested-in preferences.
* Country, state and city.
* Multiple profile photographs.
* About Me / Bio.
* Education and profession.
* Languages.
* Hobbies and interests.
* Profile verification status.
* Profile visibility and privacy settings.

Gender options:

* Male
* Female
* Non-binary
* Other / Self-described
* Prefer not to disclose

Sexual orientation options:

* Straight
* Gay
* Lesbian
* Bisexual
* Pansexual
* Asexual
* Other / Self-described
* Prefer not to disclose

The matching system must respect individual preferences and privacy.

5. Global Location-Based Discovery

* Automatically detect current location with user permission.
* Find nearby profiles based on geographical distance.
* Allow manual country, state and city selection.
* Allow users to search profiles from any selected location.

Radius selection:

* 5 KM
* 10 KM
* 25 KM
* 50 KM
* 100 KM
* 250 KM
* 500 KM

* Public Photos: Visible to eligible users.
* Private Photos: Hidden by default.

Photo request functionality:

* Display a Private Photos indicator on profiles.
* Allow users to send photo viewing requests.
* Notify profile owners about incoming requests.
* Allow users to accept or reject requests.
* Display private photographs only after approval.
* Allow owners to revoke photo access anytime.
* Support individual photo permissions.
* Maintain pending, accepted and rejected request history.
* Provide protection against unauthorized downloads and screenshots where technically supported.

* Like other profiles.
* Send interest.
* Accept or reject interests.
* Withdraw sent interests.
* View received interests.
* View sent interests.
* Add profiles to favourites/shortlist.
* Receive notifications for new interests.

Matching workflow:

* User A sends interest to User B.
* User B receives a notification.
* User B accepts the interest.
* System creates a mutual match.
* Both users receive match notifications.
* Chat and calling become available according to privacy settings.

8. Chat & Messaging

* Real-time one-to-one chat.
* Text messaging.
* Image sharing.
* Emojis and stickers.
* Voice messages.
* Message delivery status.
* Read receipts.
* Typing indicators.
* Online/offline status.
* Last-seen privacy controls.
* Message notifications.
* Block and report functionality.

9. Voice Calling

* One-to-one voice calls.
* Incoming call notifications.
* Accept/reject calls.
* Mute/unmute microphone.
* Speaker functionality.
* Call history.
* Missed call notifications.

10. Video Calling

* One-to-one HD video calls.
* Front/rear camera switching.
* Camera and microphone controls.
* Incoming video call notifications.
* Accept/reject calls.
* Network quality adaptation.
* Call history.

Use WebRTC or an equivalent real-time communication technology.

Voice and video calls should require mutual matching and appropriate consent.

11. Advanced Search & Filters

Allow users to filter profiles based on:

* Age range.
* Gender.
* Sexual orientation preferences.
* Country.
* State.
* City.
* Distance radius.
* Verified profiles only.
* Online users.
* Languages.
* Interests.
* Profession.
* Education.

Allow users to save preferred search filters.

12. Notifications

Implement push and in-app notifications for:

* New likes and interests.
* Accepted interests.
* New matches.
* Photo viewing requests.
* Accepted/rejected photo requests.
* New messages.
* Incoming voice calls.
* Incoming video calls.
* Verification updates.
* Security alerts.

13. Security & Privacy

* Secure authentication and authorization.
* OTP verification.
* Face liveness verification.
* HTTPS/TLS encryption.
* Secure database and media storage.
* Role-based access controls.
* User blocking and reporting.
* Fake account and spam detection.
* Suspicious login detection.
* Device/session management.
* Account and personal data deletion.
* Privacy and consent management.
* Compliance with applicable international data protection laws.

14. Admin Dashboard (Web)

Develop a separate web-based admin panel with:

* Dashboard and analytics.
* Total registered users.
* Active/inactive users.
* Verified/unverified users.
* User profile management.
* Face verification management.
* Photo moderation.
* User complaints and reports.
* Account suspension and banning.
* Country/state/city management.
* Matching and engagement analytics.
* Subscription management.
* Notification management.
* Fraud and suspicious activity monitoring.
* Admin roles and permissions.
* Audit logs.

15. Recommended Technology Stack

* Mobile App: Flutter.
* Backend: Node.js / NestJS.
* APIs: REST API.
* Database: PostgreSQL.

* Cache: Redis.
* Cloud: AWS.
* Image Storage: Amazon S3.
* Authentication: AWS Cognito or equivalent.
* Face Verification: AWS Rekognition or specialist verification provider.
* Real-Time Chat: WebSockets.
* Voice/Video: WebRTC.
* Notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple APNs.
* Admin Dashboard: React.js / Next.js.
* Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch.

Developers can recommend equivalent technologies based on performance, scalability and cost.

16. Main Application Screens

* Splash and Welcome Screen.
* Registration and Login.
* OTP Verification.
* Profile Creation.
* Face Verification.
* Home / Discover Profiles.
* Nearby Profiles.
* Location Selection.

* Voice Calling.
* Video Calling.
* Notifications.
* User Settings.
* Privacy Settings.
* Blocked Users.
* Report User.
* Subscription and Membership.
* Help and Support.

17. Scalability & Performance

* Scalable backend architecture.
* Optimized location-based searches.
* Efficient image and video delivery.
* Database indexing.
* API rate limiting.
* Caching and background processing.
* Load balancing.
* Automated backups.
* Monitoring and logging.
* Disaster recovery.

18. Development Deliverables

* Complete UI/UX design.
* iOS application.
* Android application.
* Backend and database development.
* API documentation.
* Face verification integration.
* Chat, voice and video calling.
* Admin dashboard.
* Cloud deployment.
* Security and performance testing.
* App Store submission.
* Google Play Store submission.
* Complete source code and technical documentation.
* Deployment credentials and project handover.

19. Development Milestones

* Phase 1: UI/UX and architecture.
* Phase 2: Registration and profiles.
* Phase 3: Face verification.
* Phase 4: Location-based discovery.
* Phase 5: Likes, interests and matching.
* Phase 6: Private photo requests.
* Phase 7: Chat, voice and video calling.
* Phase 8: Admin dashboard.
* Phase 9: Testing, security and optimization.
* Phase 10: Production deployment and launch.

20. Developer Proposal Required

Please review the requirements and provide:

* Proposed system architecture.
* UI/UX design proposal.
* Technology stack.
* Estimated development cost.
* Estimated delivery timeline.
* Third-party API and service costs.
* Cloud hosting and infrastructure costs.
* Monthly maintenance costs.
* Security and scalability plan.
* Post-launch support.

Final Objective: Build a premium, secure, globally accessible dating and matchmaking application with verified profiles, location-based discovery, private photo sharing, mutual matching, real-time chat, voice calls and video calls. The complete source code and ownership must be handed over after development.

Review and improve meta titles and descriptions.

Optimize H1, H2, and H3 headings.

Ensure proper keyword placement within page content.

Improve existing product category descriptions where required.

Avoid keyword stuffing and unnecessary repetition.

Resolve keyword cannibalization between similar product categories.

Improve content readability without removing important technical information.

Avoid duplicate content across similar product categories.

C. Technical SEO

Review website indexing and crawlability.

Identify and fix broken links, redirect errors, and duplicate meta information.

Check canonical URLs and XML sitemap configuration.

Review [login to view URL] and indexing directives.

Improve page loading speed and Core Web Vitals where technically feasible.

Check mobile usability and website structure.

Review structured data/schema markup where applicable.

Identify technical issues affecting organic search performance.

D. Internal Linking

Improve internal links between relevant product categories and product pages.

Link related valve types, materials, and industrial applications naturally.

Improve website navigation and internal link relevance.

Optimize relevant keywords for German and European search intent.

Power generation and energy.

Chemical processing and automation.

Water and wastewater treatment.

Engineering and B2B publications.
